facts.fact: 她借祖母那个"祖宗对你失望"的瞪眼，让 Archie 收住了过分紧张的笑。
facts.anchor: Kiamling gave him Por Por’s famous your ancestors are disappointed in you glare, and it did the trick.

facts.fact: Archie 把巫术说成与教会对立的异端。
facts.anchor: “Witchcraft is sinful heresy, devil worship. In antithesis to the Church.”

facts.fact: Kiamling 换话头，问他"文化交流"怎么了。
facts.anchor: “What happened to cultural exchange?”

facts.fact: 她要他想想学本地语言能让自己对祖国有用。
facts.anchor: Be indispensable to your country.

facts.fact: 她把话说到 evil 时，他的手攥紧了十字架。
facts.anchor: Archie’s hand tightened around the crucifix.

facts.fact: 她改口提起教会做过驱魔这件事。
facts.anchor: “You mentioned before that the Church conducted exorcisms.”

facts.fact: 他说仙灵不存在时还四下张望，像怕有人朝他扔石头。
facts.anchor: looking around as if someone was about to cast stones in his direction.

facts.fact: 他把仙灵说成长着翅膀的小小人、爱恶作剧。
facts.anchor: The fair folk are magical tricksters, appearing as small winged humans.

facts.fact: 他把 Ng Choy 身边的那个圈认成仙灵圈。
facts.anchor: The circle around Mr Ng, well, it looked very much like a fairy ring, even if there were no toadstools to be seen.

facts.fact: 他列出盐、铁、圣水、银和花楸木这几样。
facts.anchor: “Salt, of course. Iron, holy water, silver and rowan wood.”

facts.fact: 教堂空着，牧师已去澳门办事。
facts.anchor: St John’s was empty; the reverend had departed for business in Macau.

facts.fact: 她用一句反问否掉了去警察局带枪的提议。
facts.anchor: “Guns against fae? Has that ever worked?”

facts.fact: 火灾那夜她吓得僵住，任由裂隙合上，这件事没人知道。
facts.anchor: No one knew that she had frozen in fear on the night of the fires, letting the rift close.

facts.fact: 她说再拖下去 Ng Choy 可能永远回不来、被永久困在里面。
facts.anchor: “Because any longer and I worry that Ng Choy might not be able to come back. He’ll be stuck in there permanently.”

facts.fact: 她打断教会那套说法，逼他自己回答他信什么。
facts.anchor: “Never mind what the Church says. What do you believe, Archie?”

facts.fact: 她从屠夫 Fung 那里弄到一把铁菜刀。
facts.anchor: Still, she’d procured an iron cleaver from Fung gor, the butcher, so that was something.

facts.fact: 她不管别人质疑，还是去市场买了柚叶。
facts.anchor: Stubbornly resolute, she bought pomelo leaves from the market anyway.

facts.fact: Archie 反复叮嘱她只绕九次、不能十次。
facts.anchor: “Nine times, not ten!” Archie told her for the umpteenth time.

facts.fact: 穿墙落地后她觉得像被一头大象坐过。
facts.anchor: It felt like an elephant had sat on her.

facts.fact: 她仍被那九个圈拴在那栋楼上，另一端的线轴掉在地上。
facts.anchor: She was still attached to the building, anchored through the nine loops.
